_comment_top: Claude Code project settings for specwright. Hooks are registered automatically by the specwright plugin (no hooks block needed here). Add project-specific settings below.

_schema_notes._hook_output_format: spec-gate emits dual-format JSON for forward and backward CLI compatibility.
_schema_notes._both_emitted: Both fields are present in the same JSON object. The CLI reads whichever it understands; the other field is ignored harmlessly.

_legacy_manual_install_note._comment: If you installed specwright via the manual installer (not the plugin), hooks are NOT auto-registered. Add the hooks block from install/README.md to this file to wire them up, then restart Claude Code.
